title: Reading numbered parts with the Eureka band
summary: The interviewer asks whether newer players can fake a tune after hearing it. Dejan says those who never heard it must read, and tells of playing number 51 in the Eureka band and being careful not to miss a note.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
